scope: Read-only diagnosis of live NewsStand archive search. No public or canonical path was edited.

petsItem.headline: What does a ChatGPT pet actually do?
petsItem.summary: Say you are planning a birthday dinner in a notes app and want ChatGPT to suggest a grocery list.

liveEvidence.liveBrowserReproduction: A fresh headless Chrome visit to the live URL, with blank date/theme/concept filters, entered exact query 'pets' and returned '0 back issues found.'

cause: Certain search terms available in an admitted story are deliberately absent from its archive-index projection. The current search haystack is headline, summary, edition, desk, date, themes, concepts and status. For the Pets item, the singular headline 'pet' and its summary/themes/concepts do not contain the plural query 'pets'. Its approved story tags contain 'Pets', but tags, source labels and story text are omitted from archiveItemSearchText. This is not a stale archive-index or cache failure, and blank filters rule out a narrowed search.

proposedRepairReview.proposal: For a non-retracted indexed story whose corresponding current story passes contract.accessDecision(data, story, {scope:'search'}, now), append storySearchText(story) to archiveItemSearchText(item).
proposedRepairReview.assessment: ACCEPT. It fulfils the visitor promise to search a tag or source, makes exact 'pets' find the admitted Pets story, and keeps archive projection, ordering, rendering, date/theme/concept filtering and admission enforcement unchanged.
requiredGuards: Resolve the story only from a story: archive id.
Do not add full-story text for a retracted item.
Require the same search-scope contract access decision before adding the text.
Do not use this richer text to manufacture archive items absent from the admitted index.

limits: This diagnosis does not by itself test the forthcoming code change.

A separately observed early-load race can make an archive search run before the index arrives, but the live fresh reproduction occurred after normal network-idle loading and still returned zero; it is not the cause of this Pets result.
